records.title: Treat cite-only docs as docs-backed input
records.description: Any startup path that decides whether a run is docs-backed or code-only must treat plaintext files under reference_docs/cite/ as valid documentation input, so cite-only repos are not downgraded to code-only mode or warned as such.

records.title: Use one recognized-docs predicate for warnings and state evaluation
records.description: Operator-visible warnings, documentation-state evaluation, and the formal-doc banner must share the same recognized-plaintext rules so README-only, binary-only, cite-only, and top-level plaintext trees produce one consistent classification.

records.title: Limit Tier 4 ingest to the documented reference-docs surface
records.description: Only top-level plaintext files under reference_docs/ may be treated as Tier 4 context unless the documented contract is explicitly widened; nested archival folders outside reference_docs/cite/ must not silently join Phase 1 context.

records.title: Preserve citable-vs-context placement during bootstrap mirroring
records.description: The bootstrap self-audit helper must mirror both top-level context docs and cite/ formal docs into reference_docs/ while preserving their placement, so self-audit runs keep the same evidence tiers as the source bootstrap corpus.

records.title: Enforce the full Phase 1 exploration gate mechanically
records.description: Phase 1 validation must reject quality/EXPLORATION.md files that omit the exact mandatory sections and minimum analytical content named by the playbook's Phase 2 gate, so later phases cannot proceed on structurally shallow exploration artifacts.
records.functional_section: Phase Gates and Role Map Integrity

records.title: Parse canonical titled BUG headings in archive summaries
records.description: Archive and index rendering must count bugs from the canonical heading form `### BUG-NNN: Title`, so archived severity and disposition totals remain aligned with the BUGS.md format the rest of the playbook requires.

records.title: Normalize direct Phase 1 role maps before gate validation
records.description: A freshly written Phase 1 role map must either validate directly or be normalized automatically on every execution path before validation runs, so direct skill-mode and runner-driven paths converge on the same canonical role-map schema.
records.functional_section: Phase Gates and Role Map Integrity

records.title: Keep historical playbook output out of intrinsic surface accounting
records.description: Phase 1 inventory and downstream reasoning must continue to classify prior quality/ artifacts as playbook-output and bucket them into other_share, so historical output never inflates the repository's apparent code or skill surface.
records.functional_section: Phase Gates and Role Map Integrity
